turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Here’s how gift exchanges work: - The recipient can start an exchange online at the [Returns Center](https://fahertybrand.loopreturns.com/#/). - They’ll need the order number (PO# from the packing slip) or your name/email. - Exchanges for a new size are free and easy. - If they want a different style or color, they’ll return the item for store credit and can use that to shop for something new.
